freePlan.limits: Up to 3 builders and 5 combined app users; no custom domain included.

keyLimits.en: Up to 3 builders and 5 combined app users; no custom domain.
2 builders, up to 10 team users (max 50), up to 50 client users (max 250); extra builders cost extra per month.
3 builders, up to 30 team users (max 100), up to 100 client users (max 500), 10 custom user groups; extra builders cost extra per month.
Custom limits, advanced data sources (e.g. Snowflake, BigQuery) and custom integrations.

addOns.en: Extra builder seats on Pro and Business plans cost an additional $10-$24/month each depending on plan.

cautions.en: Softr updated its pricing plans effective August 2026; older plan names and prices found elsewhere online may be stale.
'Users' are split between internal team users and external client users, each with separate caps that scale with the plan; deactivated users don't count toward the limit.

capabilities.en: No-code builder for internal tools, client portals and web apps on top of databases (e.g. Airtable, Google Sheets, native Softr tables).
Built-in workflow automation and user management (team vs. client user groups with permissions).
Native integrations and, on Enterprise, connections to advanced data sources like Snowflake and BigQuery.

limitations.en: Builder seats (people who can edit the app) are capped per plan and cost extra beyond the included count.
Free plan has no custom domain support, limiting its use for anything beyond internal testing.

reason.en: No-code app builder targeting a similar audience of internal tools and client portals, already listed as a current alternative.
No-code app builder alternative for teams that need more custom app logic than Softr's data-source-first model offers.
No-code internal tools and workflow platform targeting a similar operations/business use case.
